items.text: Bari seuri, Hooman neunggeul tonggong kuring tarik pisan, sarta gula batu éta ngaluncat kana tikoro kuring.
items.q: Hooman thumps Amir on the back while he drinks tea. A Persian image kept word for word: can you guess what happens?

items.text: Ulah dibéjakeun ka si Eskandar pikakeuheul éta, bisi manéhna diuk deui sajam méré naséhat ka urang, dahareun kuring jadi racun oray.
items.q: A student got a big portion of rice and fears a friend's lecture. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Mun maneh hayang mawa mobil-mobilan éta, sok atuh.
items.q: Taghi agrees to the fight, on one condition. Is that clear?
before: Treuk aya dina leungeun kuring tapi teu bisa lumpat kabur. Negar nangtung jeung keur neuteupan urang. Taghi nyarita:

items.text: Kuring gé, sanggeus dipaksa kulawarga asup kana kandang hayam, kakara ngarti dunya béda kacida di sisi séjén carita.
items.q: A friend talks about his own life after his family pushed him. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Budak Baba ngadorong roda kai jambon leutikna jeung viizj-viizj ngajauhan.
items.q: Is 'roda kai' the right word for a child's kick scooter?
before: Aya sora ti tukangeun kuring nyarita:
– Enya, lék dipeselkeun. Mun aya duit engké, boneka nu leuwih alus lék dipeselkeun keur manéh, budak Baba.

items.text: Manéhna budak lalaki leutik, buukna panjang jeung meber, panonna gedé, kulitna hideung kaboseun, sarta sirahna leutik pisan nu upama teu aya buuk meberna gé bakal katempo leutik dina awakna nu leutik.
items.q: Is it clear his head would look tiny if he had no hair?
before: – Salaam. Ngaran kuring Meysam. Petugas asrama nyuruh kuring datang ka kamar 403.
Manéhna tetep nangtung hareupeun panto satengah muka, teu ngomong nanaon.

items.text: Waktu manéhna nyarita geus ngadéngé stan Mazandaran poé ieu méré kolang-kaling hejo jeung sayuran nu teu apal ngaranna, kuring nempo diri kuring leumpang gigireun Farid turun tangga paméran Kota Kuring-Budaya Kuring.
items.q: A fair stall hands out sour green plums. Is 'kolang-kaling' the right word?
before: – Sepuh, hudang indit saméméh Farid Maung Tutul nyieun gerakan maéhan ka anjeun.
Pikiran gerakan maéhan Farid ngageter kuring saeutik, tapi kuring teu boga sumanget atawa tanaga. Kuring ngan ngukuhkeun cangkéng kuring saeutik.

items.text: Manéhna teu datang. Kuring ngarasa deudeuh jajantung, aya nu meupeuskeun beuheung kuring.
items.q: Niloofar has not come. Is it clear Amir feels a choking in his throat?
before: – Minggu ieu abdi pisan teu gaduh waktos. Minggu payun, Kemis jam tilu, di tempat sarua jeung basa nu kamari urang patepung. Ieu ogé abdi bejakeun, abdi ngan gaduh waktos satengah jam.

…heula. Poé-poé saméméh patepung urang ogé kuring datang. Kuring leumpang di jero koridor-koridor fakultas bari ngabayangkeun yén saminggu deui, genep poé deui, lima poé deui, opat poé deui, tilu poé deui, dua poé deui, isukan, di dieu kénéh kuring bakal diuk gigireun Niloofar. Jam geus liwat tilu.
